root_cause.text: The mailbox-test driver unconditionally frees both tdev->tx_channel and tdev->rx_channel without checking if they are the same channel, causing a double-free when the RX channel is aliased to the TX channel.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds checks `if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)` before freeing rx_channel, both in the probe error path and the remove function, indicating that the original code lacked this alias detection and would free the same channel twice.

intent_record.intent_summary: Added a guard to avoid double freeing the same mailbox channel when rx and tx channels are identical.
intent_record.what: Changed the condition for freeing tdev->rx_channel from 'if (tdev->rx_channel)' to 'if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)'.
intent_record.how: Prevents a double-free of the same channel pointer when tdev->rx_channel equals tdev->tx_channel, avoiding potential memory corruption or use-after-free.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix potential double-free bug by ensuring the rx_channel is freed only if it is distinct from tx_channel.
intent_record.what: Added a condition to also check that tdev->rx_channel is not equal to tdev->tx_channel before freeing the rx_channel.
intent_record.how: This prevents a double-free scenario where mbox_free_channel is called on the same channel pointer twice, which could occur if the driver uses a single channel for both rx and tx.

candidates.rationale: This statement frees tdev->tx_channel. When combined with the subsequent unconditional free of tdev->rx_channel, a double-free occurs if both channels are aliased to the same underlying channel.

This statement frees tdev->rx_channel without first checking whether it is the same as tdev->tx_channel. If they are aliased, this results in a double-free since the channel was already freed by the preceding statement.
This statement frees tdev->tx_channel. It participates in the same vulnerable pattern as in the first cleanup path; freeing both channels unconditionally causes a double-free when they are the same.

This statement frees tdev->rx_channel without checking for aliasing with tx_channel. This is the direct cause of the double-free in the second cleanup path, as the channel may already have been freed.

Author: Wolfram Sang <wsa+renesas@sang-engineering.com>
Date:   Fri Apr 10 14:53:00 2026 +0200

    mailbox: mailbox-test: free channels on probe error
    
    On probe error, free the previously obtained channels. This not only
    prevents a leak, but also UAF scenarios because the client structure
    will be removed nonetheless because it was allocated with devm.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit adds an error path (err_free_chans) that unconditionally frees both tdev->tx_channel and tdev->rx_channel via separate if statements without checking if they are the same channel. If the RX channel is aliased to the TX channel, this results in a double-free. No aliasing check or NULL-after-free is present in the added code, so the vulnerability is introduced.
